description: This file defines the UriComparator class with a method to determine if two URIs are cross-origin, based on host, scheme, and port comparisons.

classes.name: UriComparator
classes.description: Provides static methods to compare URIs for cross-origin status.

methods.name: isCrossOrigin
methods.description: Checks if a modified URI is cross-origin relative to an original URI.

methods.name: computePort
methods.description: Calculates the port for a URI, defaulting to 80 or 443 based on the scheme.
